text:
jamie-finance: Heads up — NL tax office rejected our OSS submission for BrightReseller. This came in 30m before the nightly invoice run. We need guidance on whether to bill, hold, or reroute.

oliver-legal: Can you paste the rejection verbatim and the account id? Need to see the reason.

jamie-finance: Account: BR-9982. Rejection text below:
```
Belastingdienst notice:
'Registration denied: intermediary applicant located outside the EU must appoint an EU fiscal representative. Submission via NL OSS for non-union intermediaries cannot be accepted. See NL-Tax ref NL/OSS/2026/9921 for details.'
```

tia-tax-consult: Not unusual. Options: 1) reseller obtains EU fiscal rep (fastest fix), 2) reseller registers their own OSS in an EU member state that allows non-union registrants (sometimes possible), 3) fallback to standard VAT per country for B2C sales (more operational work). Immediate pragmatic move: suspend OSS handling for BR-9982 and mark charges as "VAT to be determined" so invoices don't apply OSS zero-rating.

sam-ops: From a pipeline POV we can either: A) skip invoice generation for that account (hold), B) generate invoices with a special note and no applied OSS rules, or C) run invoices but add a tax advisory line and flag for manual review. Which does finance prefer?

jamie-finance: Prefer to issue invoices for cashflow but without OSS logic so VAT is charged at destination rates or handled by reseller depending on their contract. If we can't compute destination VAT reliably, issue pro-forma and delay final. I vote for pro-forma + reconciliation.

billing-bot: Action: tax_flag "requires_fiscal_rep_nl" added to account BR-9982. Invoice-run hook will emit pro-forma only and create manual review ticket TG-3127.

oliver-legal: Legal asks reseller to provide: 1) copy of fiscal representative POA or registration evidence, 2) written confirmation of who is responsible for VAT liabilities (indemnity preferred), 3) timeline to resolve. We can withhold OSS benefits until docs received. Also recommend we estimate potential retroactive VAT exposure and note it in the partner file.

lina-partner-ops: I'll ping the partner success lead and queue a message to BrightReseller. Suggested message: short explain + ask for POA and ETA within 7 business days, CC legal. Want to run it by legal before sending.

tia-tax-consult: I'll prepare a short checklist and template email for the partner ops team (POA sample, acceptable evidence, timeline expectations). ETA 8 hours.

jamie-finance: OK team — plan: 1) apply pro-forma hold (billing-bot done), 2) partner ops will contact reseller with checklist (lina), 3) legal to draft indemnity wording if requested (oliver), 4) tax consult to provide template (tia). We'll reconvene after reseller responds or by EOD tomorrow.

sam-ops: Noted — we'll stop automated retries and ensure the billing run marks the account as manual.

billing-bot: Note logged: TG-3127 created for manual tax review. Next invoice cycle will not finalize charges for BR-9982.

jamie-finance: Thanks. tagging @lina-partner-ops and @oliver-legal for follow-ups.
